plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you share them with your friends.
plugins.cameraPermission: The app accesses your camera to let you take photos and share them with your friends.

plugins.accessPrivileges: The app needs access to your media library to let you share photos with your friends.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: The app needs access to your location to show it on your profile and let your friends see where you are.
